segments.text: A self-proclaimed angel, she was sent down from heaven to protect the Demon Lord's reincarnation, Riku.
Despite her youthful appearance, she's actually quite a level-headed and responsible girl.
She approaches her angelic duties optimistically, and always treats those she meets with genuine sincerity.
Being an angel comes with its drawbacks, though. Most notably, a significant lack of contact with human society.
Noa makes the most of this, though, and even finds joy in consuming the various products of human culture she encounters―from anime and manga, to all the delicious food she can get her hands on.
As you'd expect from angel, she's a very pure-hearted girl, so she can't handle dirty talk very well.
From NekoNyan's official Twitter
天使の女の子
魔王の生まれ変わりである主人公を守るため、彼の元に舞い降りた
見た目は幼いが、大人びた雰囲気の少女
冷静沈着、天使の仕事に対する姿勢は前向きで、周囲には真摯な態度で接する
天使として生きてきたため、これまでに地上の文化にはほとんど触れてこなかった
そのため漫画やアニメを見たり、美味しい物を食べたりと、地上での暮らしを満喫する
穢れなき天使であるため、エッチなことは苦手である

Riku's younger sister, who was also a demon in her past life.
She can be somewhat shy with strangers, but once you get to know her, she's actually a very lively girl.
And despite how bratty she can act toward Riku, overall they have a pretty good relationship.
She's also a huge gamer girl, and often stays up really late playing various online games.
Unfortunately, this tends to backfire on her the following morning.

One of Riku's classmates, who was also a demon before she was reincarnated on earth.
She's a bubbly, charismatic girl at heart, making her quite popular with her fellow classmates.
She can befriend almost anyone at the drop of a hat, but she's also good at reading people, so she never forces her friendship on others.
This unique talent bodes well for her, as she likes being around people, especially friends, and gets lonely easily.
Her loneliness has been something of a problem lately, however, as she's been struggling to find people to play games with.

A visitor from another world, who came to earth in pursuit of the reincarnated Demon Lord after learning of his existence.
She seems to have noble lineage, but prefers to do things herself instead of relying on others.
Kaguya is a cheerful, but mild-mannered girl, who loves pampering others.
She's a little on the mischievous side, though, and sometimes plays tricks on her friends just to get a reaction out of them.
She's really enjoying her life in Japan, and finds the culture and lifestyle very exciting.
Careful around her animal ears, they're very sensitive!

Kaguya's caretaker and constant companion, who accompanied her in her search for Riku.
She is troubled by the fact that Kaguya, her master, does everything by herself, so she fears that she's not properly fulfilling her responsibilities as her caretaker.
She takes her job very seriously, but her stubborn, no-nonsense approach, and her clumsiness can make her come across as awkward at times.
Electronics are quite literally a foreign concept to her, much to her chagrin.

Riku's homeroom teacher. An old friend of the family, she's known him ever since her days as a student.
She's calm and friendly, making her very well-liked among her students.
As Riku's teacher, she's careful to maintain a modicum of professionalism around him, but she still sometimes gives him special treatment.
Her behavior changes completely outside of the classroom, where she acts less like a full-grown adult and more like a spoiled kid.

Masaomi's cousin who is one year younger than him. Though she's normally kind, when it comes to her brother, Rentarou, she turns rather strict. Works at a nearby Japanese sweets shop.
Edited from NekoNyan
主人公の従妹であり、一つ下の女の子。明るく優しい性格なのだが、実兄である鞍馬廉太郎には手厳しい。甘味処でアルバイトをしている。
地元の甘味処でアルバイトをしている、主人公の従妹。
基本的には優しい性格だが、兄の廉太郎にだけはやけに冷たい。
「折角誘ってもらえたんだから……たまにはお兄ちゃんと食べよっかな」
An older girl who was friends with the protagonist when they were kids. She has since graduated school and now manages her parents' sweets shop.
She often plays up her age, but in reality she has no experience with romance.
From NekoNyan
主人公と子供の頃から一緒に遊んでいた年上のお姉さん。学院はすでに卒業しており、実家の甘味処を作成させて経営している。年上ぶる事も多いが、恋愛経験はない。
年上の幼なじみにして、甘味処のオーナー。
主人公とは歳が離れているせいか、お姉さん的な目線で話し掛けてくる。
「おやまあっ。 本当に小生意気に育っちゃって、この」
A spirited girl who's full of energy. Her personality is so straightforward you'd never believe she could tell a lie.
She has trouble processing complicated things, so she prefers things simple and easy to understand.
She's friends with Nozomi, and although they don't go to school together anymore, they used to have classes together.

She has a clear childish side to her. She loves stuffed animals and everything cute. Similarly, she loves being pampered, especially by her parents, which is why she hates doing chores around the house.
She's also a former member of the swim team. Her tanned skin hasn't gone back to normal, which is a slight concern for her.
From official website
元気で活力あふれた女の子。
裏表を感じさせない明るさを持っていて、ゴチャゴチャしたことが苦手で、単純明快な方が好き。
今は別のところに通っているが、昔は墨染希と同じクラスだったこともある。
子どもっぽい一面があり、ぬいぐるみなど、可愛い物が好き。
甘えたがりなところもあり、親にも甘えているので、家事は苦手。
元水泳部。

Protagonist of this game.
He was the demon lord in his previous life, and lost something important because of this.
He's somewhat lazy, but takes responsibility for any task that he does undertake.
He has a younger sister, Tanikaze Amane, who he is relatively close with.
(Translated from Official Pamphlete)
Riku's classmate.
She's a gyaru and good friends with Chika and Kurumi. The three of them can often be seen hanging out together.
She's soft-spoken and often makes random comments, but she has an honest personality and apologizes immediately when she has to.
Translated from the official website
Riku's classmate.
She's good friends with Kaede and Kurumi, and the three of them can often be seen hanging out together.
She is the calmer of the three, and naturally chimes in as the voice of reason.
She gives off a somewhat sluggish aura.
Translated from the official website
Amane's classmate.
She's shy, but good friends with her regardless.
She likes to play games, so they often play them together.
Translated from the official website
Riku and Amane's mother.
A great mom to both of her children, and a loving wife to her husband. She's always positive and upbeat.
Given that she also works full-time, the housework often falls to Riku and Amane (though Riku handles the vast majority of it).
